renderings.kjv: thus to me with a strong

elsewhere.note: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.
For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
“Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia; and the fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong…
